verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents monitors that automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP against control requirements. It also provides a Monitors page for investigating violations, alerting on compliance violations, and a dashboard that flags controls needing attention, so failing controls surface well before the audit. Its own docs, however, say monitors refresh 'up to daily or ad-hoc', which falls short of a guaranteed within-hours cadence. Missing for 10: documented sub-daily/hourly test cadence, detail on monitor coverage and alert delivery channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.
